missing.what_was_said: Management anticipated a 20–30 million-can inventory reduction in the coming months, effectively delayed from Q3 because of strong September promotional activity. This materially qualified the shipment outlook.

Management reported that 2025 U.S. ZYN shipments grew 37%, or 213 million cans, to 794 million. It attributed the gap between shipments and consumer offtake to a net channel-inventory rebuild and estimated the underlying shipment base corresponding to consumer offtake at approximately 740–750 million cans.
